controls.name: information security policy
controls.description: An information security policy document shall be approved by document management, and published and communicated to all employees and relevant external parties.

deployment_points.name: Draft the information security policy document outlining the organization's security objectives and guidelines.
Submit the draft policy to document management for review and approval, ensuring it meets compliance requirements.
Publish the approved policy on the organization's intranet or other accessible platforms for all employees.
Conduct training sessions or workshops to communicate the policy to employees and relevant external parties.
Establish a feedback mechanism to gather input on the policy's effectiveness and areas for improvement.

controls.name: review of the information security policy
controls.description: The information security policy shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular review intervals for the information security policy, such as annually or bi-annually.
Assign a team responsible for conducting the review, including representatives from key departments.
Evaluate the policy against current security threats, compliance requirements, and organizational changes.
Document any changes or updates to the policy and obtain necessary approvals for revisions.
Communicate any updates to the policy to all employees and relevant external parties promptly.

controls.name: management commitment to information security
controls.description: Management shall actively support security within the organization through clear direction, demonstrated commitment, explicit assignment, and acknowledgment of information security responsibilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear information security strategy that aligns with the organization's overall objectives and values.
Communicate the importance of information security to all employees through meetings, emails, and training sessions.
Assign specific information security roles and responsibilities to management and staff, ensuring accountability.
Regularly review and report on the status of information security initiatives to demonstrate management's commitment.
Foster a culture of security awareness by recognizing and rewarding employees who contribute to information security efforts.

controls.name: information security coordination
controls.description: Information security activities shall be co-ordinated by representatives from different parts of the organization with relevant roles and job functions.

deployment_points.name: Identify key representatives from various departments who will participate in information security coordination efforts.
Establish a cross-functional information security committee to facilitate communication and collaboration.
Schedule regular meetings to discuss ongoing security initiatives, challenges, and updates from each department.
Create a shared platform for documenting and tracking information security activities and responsibilities.
Ensure that all departments are aware of their roles in maintaining information security and provide necessary training.

controls.name: allocation of information security responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be clearly defined.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive assessment of information security roles and responsibilities across the organization.
Develop a clear organizational chart that outlines specific information security responsibilities for each role.
Communicate the defined responsibilities to all employees, ensuring they understand their individual roles in security.
Provide training and resources to support employees in fulfilling their information security responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the responsibilities as needed to reflect changes in the organization or security landscape.

controls.name: authorization process for information processing
controls.description: A management authorization process for new information processing facilities shall be defined and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal authorization process that outlines the steps required for approving new information processing facilities.
Define criteria for evaluating the security risks associated with new facilities before authorization.
Assign a management team responsible for reviewing and approving requests for new information processing facilities.
Document all authorization decisions and maintain records for accountability and compliance purposes.
Regularly review the authorization process to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational security policies.

controls.name: confidentiality agreements
controls.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organizationΓÇÖs needs for the protection of information shall be identified and regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of information that require confidentiality agreements based on organizational needs and legal requirements.
Develop standard confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement templates for use across the organization.
Ensure that all employees and relevant external parties sign the agreements before accessing sensitive information.
Schedule regular reviews of the agreements to ensure they remain relevant and effective in protecting information.
Provide training on the importance of confidentiality agreements and the consequences of breaches to all employees.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities and regulatory bodies that the organization must maintain contact with for information security matters.
Designate specific individuals or teams responsible for managing relationships with these authorities.
Establish a communication plan outlining how and when to engage with authorities, including reporting requirements.
Maintain records of all communications with authorities for accountability and compliance purposes.
Regularly review and update contact information and communication protocols to ensure effectiveness.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, forums, and professional associations related to information security.
Designate representatives from the organization to participate in these groups and forums.
Establish a schedule for regular engagement with these groups, including attending meetings and conferences.
Share insights and best practices gained from participation with the broader organization to enhance security efforts.
Regularly assess the value of these contacts and adjust participation as necessary to align with organizational goals.

controls.name: independent review of information security
controls.description: The organizationΓÇÖs approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes to the security implementation occur.

deployment_points.name: Schedule independent reviews of the information security management approach at regular intervals, such as annually.
Engage external auditors or security experts to conduct the reviews for objectivity.
Develop a checklist of criteria to evaluate the effectiveness of the current information security practices.
Document the findings and recommendations from the independent review and share them with management.
Implement necessary changes based on the review findings and communicate updates to all relevant stakeholders.

controls.name: identification of risks related to external parties
controls.description: The risks to the organizationΓÇÖs information and information processing facilities from business processes involving external parties shall be identified and appropriate controls implemented before granting access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough risk assessment to identify potential risks associated with external parties, including vendors and partners.
Develop a risk register that documents identified risks, their potential impact, and likelihood of occurrence.
Implement appropriate security controls based on the risk assessment, such as access controls, monitoring, and incident response plans.
Establish a process for regularly reviewing and updating the risk assessment to account for changes in external relationships or business processes.
Train relevant staff on the identified risks and the implemented controls to ensure compliance and awareness.

controls.name: addressing security when dealing with customers
controls.description: All identified security requirements shall be addressed before giving customers access to the organizationΓÇÖs information or assets.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document all security requirements related to customer access to information and assets.
Develop a checklist of security measures that must be implemented prior to granting access to customers.
Ensure that customer agreements include clauses that address security requirements and responsibilities.
Conduct security training for employees who interact with customers to ensure they understand the security protocols in place.
Regularly review and update security measures based on customer feedback and emerging threats.

controls.name: addressing security in third party agreements
controls.description: Agreements with third parties involving accessing, processing, communicating or managing the organizationΓÇÖs information or information processing facilities shall cover all relevant security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a standard template for third-party agreements that includes security requirements and compliance obligations.
Identify all third parties that access or manage the organizationΓÇÖs information and assess their security posture.
Ensure that all agreements are reviewed by legal and security teams to confirm that security requirements are adequately addressed.
Implement a monitoring process to ensure third parties comply with the security requirements outlined in their agreements.
Conduct regular audits of third-party relationships to assess compliance with security standards and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: inventory of assets
controls.description: All assets shall be clearly identified and an inventory of all important assets drawn up and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive list of all organizational assets, including hardware, software, and data.
Assign unique identifiers to each asset for tracking and management purposes.
Develop a centralized asset management system to maintain and update the inventory regularly.
Conduct periodic audits to verify the accuracy of the asset inventory and identify any discrepancies.
Train staff on the importance of asset management and the procedures for reporting changes or new acquisitions.

controls.name: ownership of assets
controls.description: All information and assets associated with information processing facilities shall be ΓÇÿownedΓÇÖ by a designated part of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Designate specific individuals or teams as owners for each category of asset within the organization.
Document the responsibilities of asset owners, including maintenance, security, and compliance obligations.
Implement a formal process for transferring ownership of assets when necessary, ensuring all stakeholders are informed.
Conduct regular reviews to ensure that asset ownership is current and accurately reflects organizational structure.
Provide training to asset owners on their responsibilities and the importance of effective asset management.

controls.name: acceptable use of assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and assets associated with information processing facilities shall be identified, documented, and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear acceptable use policy that outlines the rules and guidelines for using organizational assets.
Ensure that the policy is communicated to all employees, contractors, and third-party users.
Implement a process for monitoring compliance with the acceptable use policy, including regular audits and reviews.
Provide training sessions to educate users about the acceptable use policy and the consequences of violations.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in technology, business practices, and legal requirements.

controls.name: classification guidelines
controls.description: Information shall be classified in terms of its value, legal requirements, sensitivity and criticality to the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes information based on its value, sensitivity, and legal requirements.
Train employees on the classification criteria and the importance of proper information classification.
Implement a process for reviewing and updating classifications as information changes or new data is created.
Ensure that all classified information is marked appropriately to indicate its classification level.
Establish access controls based on classification levels to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.

controls.name: information labelling and handling
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labeling and handling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop procedures for labeling information based on its classification, including clear marking and handling instructions.
Train employees on the proper labeling and handling procedures to ensure compliance with the classification scheme.
Implement a system for tracking and managing labeled information to prevent unauthorized access or mishandling.
Regularly review and update labeling procedures to reflect changes in classification standards or organizational needs.
Conduct audits to ensure that labeling and handling procedures are being followed and to identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Security roles and responsibilities of employees, contractors and third party users shall be defined and documented in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs information security policy.

deployment_points.name: Define and document specific security roles and responsibilities for all employees, contractors, and third-party users.
Ensure that the documented roles are aligned with the organizationΓÇÖs information security policy and objectives.
Communicate the defined roles and responsibilities to all relevant stakeholders to ensure understanding and compliance.
Implement a process for regularly reviewing and updating roles and responsibilities as organizational needs change.
Provide training to employees on their specific security roles and responsibilities to promote accountability.

controls.name: background verification checks
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment, contractors, and third party users shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics, and proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed, and the perceived risks.

deployment_points.name: Develop a background verification policy that outlines the types of checks to be conducted based on role and information access levels.
Ensure that all background checks comply with relevant laws, regulations, and ethical standards.
Implement a standardized process for conducting background checks on all candidates and third-party users.
Train HR and security personnel on the background verification process and the importance of thorough checks.
Regularly review and update the background verification policy to ensure it remains effective and compliant with changing regulations.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: As part of their contractual obligation, employees, contractors and third party users shall agree and sign the terms and conditions of their employment contract, which shall state their and the organizationΓÇÖs responsibilities for information security.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive employment contract template that includes specific terms and conditions related to information security responsibilities.
Ensure that all employees, contractors, and third-party users review and understand the terms before signing the contract.
Implement a process for tracking signed contracts to ensure compliance and maintain records for auditing purposes.
Regularly review and update the terms and conditions to reflect changes in organizational policies or legal requirements.
Provide training sessions to explain the importance of the terms and conditions and the implications of non-compliance.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require employees, contractors and third party users to apply security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear security policies and procedures that outline the responsibilities of employees, contractors, and third-party users.
Communicate these policies effectively through meetings, emails, and training sessions to ensure understanding.
Assign specific management roles to oversee compliance with security policies and procedures.
Implement regular audits and assessments to monitor adherence to security practices and identify areas for improvement.
Provide feedback and corrective actions for non-compliance to reinforce the importance of following established security protocols.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors and third party users shall receive appropriate awareness training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Develop a structured training program that includes modules on information security awareness tailored to different job functions.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to keep employees informed about the latest security policies and threats.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to engage employees effectively.
Track attendance and completion of training to ensure all relevant personnel are adequately trained.
Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback to continuously improve the content and delivery.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: There shall be a formal disciplinary process for employees who have committed a security breach.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear disciplinary policy that outlines the procedures for addressing security breaches, including potential consequences.
Ensure that all employees are aware of the disciplinary process through training and communication of the policy.
Designate a team or individual responsible for investigating security breaches and enforcing disciplinary actions.
Maintain documentation of all incidents and actions taken to ensure transparency and accountability in the process.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary process to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational goals.

controls.name: termination responsibilities
controls.description: Responsibilities for performing employment termination or change of employment shall be clearly defined and assigned.

deployment_points.name: Create a detailed termination checklist that outlines all responsibilities and actions required during the termination process.
Assign specific roles to HR, IT, and management to ensure accountability for each step of the termination process.
Conduct exit interviews to gather feedback and ensure that all organizational property and access rights are addressed.
Implement a system for tracking changes in employment status to ensure timely execution of termination responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the termination process to incorporate lessons learned and improve efficiency.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: All employees, contractors and third party users shall return all of the organizationΓÇÖs assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive asset inventory that includes all items issued to employees, contractors, and third-party users.
Create a return process that is initiated upon termination, including a checklist of assets to be returned.
Assign responsibility to a designated individual or team to oversee the return of assets and ensure compliance.
Implement a tracking system to document the return of assets and any outstanding items.
Regularly audit the asset return process to identify gaps and improve the efficiency of asset recovery.

controls.name: removal of access rights
controls.description: Removal of access rights to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

deployment_points.name: Establish a protocol for the immediate removal of access rights upon termination or change of employment status.
Create a centralized access management system to track and manage user access rights effectively.
Assign responsibility to IT personnel to ensure timely execution of access removals or adjustments.
Conduct regular audits of access rights to ensure compliance and identify any unauthorized access.
Provide training to relevant staff on the importance of timely access removal to protect organizational information.

controls.name: physical security perimeter
controls.description: Security perimeters (barriers such as walls, card controlled entry gates or manned reception desks) shall be used to protect areas that contain information and information processing facilities.

deployment_points.name: Assess the physical layout of the organization to identify areas that require security perimeters for sensitive information.
Install appropriate barriers such as walls, fences, or gates to establish secure areas around critical facilities.
Implement access control measures, such as card readers or manned reception desks, to monitor and restrict entry to authorized personnel only.
Regularly inspect and maintain physical security measures to ensure their effectiveness and address any vulnerabilities.
Develop and communicate emergency procedures for breaches of the physical security perimeter to all employees.

controls.name: physical entry controls
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

deployment_points.name: Identify secure areas within the organization that require controlled access and define the criteria for authorized personnel.
Implement entry control systems, such as key cards, biometric scanners, or security personnel, to manage access to these areas.
Train employees on the importance of access controls and the procedures for gaining entry to secure areas.
Regularly review and update access permissions to ensure they reflect current personnel and roles.
Conduct periodic audits of entry control systems to identify and rectify any weaknesses or unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in the physical security of offices, rooms, and facilities.
Design and implement security measures such as locks, alarms, and surveillance cameras to protect these areas.
Establish protocols for securing offices and rooms after hours or during periods of low occupancy.
Train staff on the importance of physical security and their role in maintaining a secure environment.
Regularly review and update physical security measures to adapt to changing threats and organizational needs.

controls.name: protecting against external environmental threats
controls.description: Physical protection against damage from fire, flood, earthquake, explosion, civil unrest, and other forms of natural or man-made disaster shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential external environmental threats specific to the location of the facility.
Design and implement physical barriers such as firewalls, flood barriers, and seismic reinforcements to mitigate identified risks.
Establish emergency response plans that include evacuation procedures and communication strategies during environmental threats.
Regularly review and update the physical protection measures to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.
Train employees on the importance of these protections and their roles in emergency situations.

controls.name: working in secure areas
controls.description: Physical protection and guidelines for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Define secure areas within the facility and establish access control measures such as key cards or biometric systems.
Implement physical barriers like locked doors and security personnel to monitor access to secure areas.
Develop and communicate guidelines for personnel working in secure areas, including protocols for visitor access and equipment usage.
Conduct regular audits of secure areas to ensure compliance with security measures and identify potential vulnerabilities.
Provide training for employees on the importance of maintaining security in these areas and recognizing unauthorized access.

controls.name: public access, delivery and loading areas
controls.description: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons may enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Identify and clearly mark all public access points, delivery, and loading areas to control entry effectively.
Install surveillance cameras and security personnel at these access points to monitor and control unauthorized access.
Implement physical barriers such as gates or fences to isolate these areas from sensitive information processing facilities.
Establish a visitor management system to log and monitor all deliveries and personnel entering these areas.
Regularly review access control measures and update them based on security assessments and incident reports.

controls.name: equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited or protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Assess the physical environment to determine optimal locations for equipment that minimize exposure to environmental threats.
Use protective enclosures or cabinets for sensitive equipment to shield against environmental hazards like dust, moisture, and temperature extremes.
Implement access controls to restrict unauthorized personnel from accessing equipment locations.
Regularly inspect and maintain protective measures to ensure they are functioning effectively against potential threats.
Document the siting and protection measures taken for equipment and review them periodically for improvements.

controls.name: supporting utilities
controls.description: Equipment shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

deployment_points.name: Install uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) to provide backup power to critical equipment during outages.
Regularly test and maintain UPS systems and backup generators to ensure they are operational when needed.
Implement monitoring systems to detect and alert personnel of utility failures or disruptions in real-time.
Develop contingency plans that outline procedures for responding to utility failures, including communication protocols.
Conduct training sessions for staff on the importance of utility protection and the steps to take during a utility failure.

controls.name: cabling security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception or damage.

deployment_points.name: Route cabling through secure pathways that are not easily accessible to unauthorized personnel.
Use protective conduits or enclosures for cabling to prevent physical damage and unauthorized access.
Implement monitoring systems to detect any tampering or unauthorized access to cabling infrastructure.
Regularly inspect cabling for signs of wear, damage, or unauthorized alterations and address any issues promptly.
Document cabling layouts and security measures in place to facilitate audits and future upgrades.

controls.name: equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be correctly maintained to ensure its continued availability and integrity.

deployment_points.name: Develop a maintenance schedule for all equipment that includes regular inspections and servicing.
Train maintenance personnel on the specific requirements and procedures for each type of equipment.
Keep detailed records of maintenance activities, including dates, actions taken, and any issues identified.
Implement a system for reporting and addressing equipment malfunctions or failures promptly.
Review and update maintenance procedures regularly to incorporate best practices and lessons learned from past experiences.

controls.name: security of equipment off-premises
controls.description: Security shall be applied to off-site equipment taking into account the different risks of working outside the organizationΓÇÖs premises.

deployment_points.name: Establish policies for the secure transport and storage of equipment taken off-site, including authorization requirements.
Use secure containers or cases for transporting equipment to prevent damage and unauthorized access.
Implement tracking systems to monitor the location and status of off-site equipment at all times.
Conduct risk assessments for off-site locations to identify potential security vulnerabilities and address them accordingly.
Provide training for employees on the risks associated with off-site equipment and the importance of following security protocols.

controls.name: secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: All items of equipment containing storage media shall be checked to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal.

deployment_points.name: Develop a secure disposal policy that outlines procedures for handling equipment containing sensitive data.
Use data wiping software to securely overwrite data on storage media before disposal or re-use.
Maintain records of all disposed or re-used equipment, including serial numbers and methods of data destruction.
Train personnel on the importance of secure disposal practices and the risks of data breaches.
Regularly audit disposal practices to ensure compliance with policies and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: removal of property
controls.description: Equipment, information or software shall not be taken off-site without prior authorization.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal authorization process for the removal of equipment, information, or software from the premises.
Implement a tracking system to log all items removed from the premises, including who authorized the removal and the purpose.
Train employees on the policies regarding the removal of property and the importance of adhering to these protocols.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the removal policies and identify any unauthorized removals.
Review and update the removal policies periodically to address any changes in operational needs or security concerns.

controls.name: documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures shall be documented, maintained, and made available to all users who need them.

deployment_points.name: Identify all critical operating procedures that require documentation and assign responsible personnel for each procedure.
Create detailed documentation for each procedure, including step-by-step instructions, roles, and responsibilities.
Implement a version control system to ensure that all documents are maintained and updated regularly.
Make the documented procedures accessible to all relevant users through a centralized repository or intranet.
Conduct regular training sessions to ensure that users are familiar with the documented procedures and any updates.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and systems shall be controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management policy that outlines the process for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes.
Implement a change request form that captures all necessary details about the proposed change, including impact analysis and rollback plans.
Set up a change advisory board (CAB) to review and approve significant changes before implementation.
Maintain a change log to document all changes made, including dates, responsible personnel, and outcomes.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess the effectiveness of changes and identify any issues that arose.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organizationΓÇÖs assets.

deployment_points.name: Analyze existing roles and responsibilities within the organization to identify areas where segregation is necessary.
Define clear job descriptions that outline specific duties and responsibilities for each role to prevent overlap.
Implement access controls that restrict users from performing conflicting duties, such as both approving and processing transactions.
Regularly review and update role assignments to ensure compliance with segregation of duties principles.
Provide training to employees on the importance of segregation of duties and the risks associated with non-compliance.

controls.name: separation of development, test and operational facilities
controls.description: Development, test and operational facilities shall be separated to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational system.

deployment_points.name: Establish distinct environments for development, testing, and production to prevent unauthorized access between them.
Implement strict access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can access the production environment.
Use automated deployment tools to manage the transition of code from development to testing and then to production.
Regularly audit access logs to monitor any unauthorized attempts to access the production environment.
Conduct training for developers and testers on the importance of maintaining separation between environments.

controls.name: service delivery
controls.description: It shall be ensured that the security controls, service definitions and delivery levels included in the third party service delivery agreement are implemented, operated, and maintained by the third party.

deployment_points.name: Review and define security controls and service delivery requirements to be included in third-party agreements.
Establish a process for evaluating third-party vendors to ensure they can meet the defined security and service delivery standards.
Include clauses in contracts that require third parties to demonstrate compliance with security controls and service levels.
Conduct regular audits and assessments of third-party services to ensure ongoing compliance with the agreement.
Maintain open communication with third-party vendors to address any issues or changes in service delivery promptly.

controls.name: monitoring and review of third party services
controls.description: The services, reports and records provided by the third party shall be regularly monitored and reviewed, and audits shall be carried out regularly.

deployment_points.name: Develop a monitoring plan that outlines the frequency and scope of reviews for third-party services.
Implement tools and processes to collect and analyze performance data and reports from third-party vendors.
Schedule regular review meetings with third-party providers to discuss performance metrics and any issues encountered.
Conduct periodic audits of third-party services to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and security standards.
Document findings from reviews and audits, and take corrective actions as necessary to address any deficiencies.

controls.name: managing changes to third party services
controls.description: Changes to the provision of services, including maintaining and improving existing information security policies, procedures and controls, shall be managed, taking account of the criticality of business systems and processes involved and re-assessment of risks.

deployment_points.name: Establish a change management process specifically for third-party services that includes risk assessment and impact analysis.
Require third-party vendors to submit change requests that detail the nature of the change and its potential impact on service delivery.
Review and approve changes based on their criticality and potential risks to business operations.
Communicate changes to all stakeholders, including internal teams and affected users, to ensure awareness and preparedness.
Monitor the implementation of changes to assess their effectiveness and address any issues that arise.

controls.name: capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned, and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools to track resource usage across systems and applications in real-time.
Analyze historical data to identify trends in resource consumption and predict future capacity needs.
Establish thresholds for resource usage that trigger alerts for potential capacity issues.
Regularly review and adjust resource allocations based on current and projected demands to optimize performance.
Document capacity management processes and ensure that they are communicated to relevant stakeholders.

controls.name: system acceptance
controls.description: Acceptance criteria for new information systems, upgrades, and new versions shall be established and suitable tests of the system(s) carried out during development and prior to acceptance.

deployment_points.name: Define clear acceptance criteria for new systems and upgrades, including functional and non-functional requirements.
Develop a testing plan that outlines the types of tests to be conducted, such as unit, integration, and user acceptance testing.
Involve end-users in the testing process to ensure that the system meets their needs and expectations.
Document test results and any issues identified during testing, along with resolutions and retesting outcomes.
Obtain formal sign-off from stakeholders before deploying new systems or upgrades into the production environment.

controls.name: controls against malicious code
controls.description: Detection, prevention, and recovery controls to protect against malicious code and appropriate user awareness procedures shall be implemented.

deployment_points.name: Implement antivirus and anti-malware solutions on all endpoints and servers to detect and prevent malicious code.
Regularly update and patch all software and systems to protect against known vulnerabilities.
Conduct user awareness training to educate employees about the risks of malicious code and safe computing practices.
Establish incident response procedures for detecting, reporting, and recovering from malware infections.
Perform regular security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address potential weaknesses in defenses against malicious code.

controls.name: controls against mobile code
controls.description: Where the use of mobile code is authorized, the configuration shall ensure that the authorized mobile code operates according to a clearly defined security policy, and unauthorized mobile code shall be prevented from executing.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive security policy that defines the acceptable use of mobile code within the organization.
Implement technical controls such as whitelisting to allow only authorized mobile code to execute on systems.
Regularly review and update the list of authorized mobile code to ensure it aligns with current security policies.
Train employees on the risks associated with mobile code and the importance of adhering to the established security policy.
Monitor and log the execution of mobile code to detect any unauthorized attempts and respond accordingly.

controls.name: information back-up
controls.description: Back-up copies of information and software shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with the agreed backup policy.

deployment_points.name: Establish a backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up information and software.
Schedule regular backups to ensure that all critical data is captured according to the policy.
Store backup copies in a secure location, both on-site and off-site, to protect against data loss.
Test backup restoration processes periodically to ensure data can be recovered successfully when needed.
Document all backup procedures and maintain records of backup activities for compliance and auditing purposes.

controls.name: network controls
controls.description: Networks shall be adequately managed and controlled, in order to be protected from threats, and to maintain security for the systems and applications using the network, including information in transit.

deployment_points.name: Implement firewalls and intrusion detection systems to monitor and control network traffic.
Regularly update network devices and software to protect against vulnerabilities and threats.
Establish access controls to limit network access to authorized users and devices only.
Conduct regular security assessments and penetration testing to identify and mitigate network vulnerabilities.
Develop incident response procedures to address any network security breaches promptly.

controls.name: security features, service levels, and management requirements of network services
controls.description: Security of network services shall be identified and included in any network services agreement, whether these services are provided in-house or outsourced.

deployment_points.name: Review and define security requirements for all network services, including data protection and access controls.
Include specific security clauses in network service agreements to ensure compliance with organizational policies.
Assess the security posture of third-party service providers before entering into agreements.
Monitor and audit network services regularly to ensure adherence to the defined security requirements.
Establish a process for updating service agreements to reflect changes in security needs or regulations.

controls.name: management of removable media
controls.description: There shall be procedures in place for the management of removable media.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document procedures for the secure handling, storage, and transportation of removable media.
Implement access controls to restrict the use of removable media to authorized personnel only.
Train employees on the risks associated with removable media and the importance of following established procedures.
Regularly audit the use of removable media to ensure compliance with management procedures.
Establish a process for securely wiping or destroying removable media that is no longer needed.

controls.name: disposal of media
controls.description: Media shall be disposed of securely and safely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

deployment_points.name: Create a formal disposal policy that outlines the methods for securely disposing of different types of media.
Ensure that all employees are trained on the disposal procedures and the importance of data protection.
Use certified data destruction services for physical media to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
Maintain records of disposed media, including the type, method of disposal, and date of disposal.
Regularly review and update disposal procedures to incorporate new technologies and best practices.

controls.name: information handling procedures
controls.description: Procedures for the handling and storage of information shall be established to protect this information from unauthorized disclosure or misuse.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear procedures for the classification, handling, and storage of sensitive information.
Train employees on the importance of information security and the specific procedures they must follow.
Implement access controls to restrict access to sensitive information based on user roles.
Regularly review and update information handling procedures to address new threats and changes in the organization.
Monitor compliance with information handling procedures and take corrective actions as necessary.

controls.name: security of system documentation
controls.description: System documentation shall be protected against unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify all system documentation based on sensitivity and criticality.

Regularly review access logs to detect any unauthorized attempts to access system documentation.
Establish a process for securely sharing system documentation with external parties when necessary.

controls.name: information exchange policies and procedures
controls.description: Formal exchange policies, procedures, and controls shall be in place to protect the exchange of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop formal policies that outline the procedures for exchanging information securely across all communication channels.
Train employees on the established information exchange policies and the importance of secure communication.
Implement encryption and other security measures for sensitive information exchanged electronically.
Regularly review and update information exchange policies to address emerging threats and technologies.
Monitor compliance with information exchange procedures and conduct audits to ensure effectiveness.

controls.name: exchange agreements
controls.description: Agreements shall be established for the exchange of information and software between the organization and external parties.

deployment_points.name: Draft exchange agreements that clearly define the terms and conditions for sharing information and software with external parties.

Review and assess the security posture of external parties before finalizing exchange agreements.
Monitor compliance with the terms of exchange agreements and address any violations promptly.
Regularly update exchange agreements to reflect changes in security requirements or business relationships.

controls.name: physical media in transit
controls.description: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation beyond an organizationΓÇÖs physical boundaries.

deployment_points.name: Identify all physical media that will be transported and classify them based on the sensitivity of the information they contain.

Implement a tracking system to monitor the location and status of the media during transportation.
Train personnel involved in the transportation process on security protocols and the importance of safeguarding the media.
Establish a chain of custody procedure to document the handling and transfer of the media throughout the transportation process.

controls.name: electronic messaging
controls.description: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected.

deployment_points.name: Implement encryption protocols for all electronic messages to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the information.
Establish access controls to ensure that only authorized users can send and receive sensitive electronic messages.
Regularly update and patch messaging software to protect against vulnerabilities and exploits.
Train employees on secure messaging practices, including recognizing phishing attempts and other threats.
Monitor and log electronic messaging activities to detect and respond to any unauthorized access or anomalies.

controls.name: business information systems
controls.description: Policies and procedures shall be developed and implemented to protect information associated with the interconnection of business information systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop comprehensive policies that outline security requirements for interconnecting business information systems.
Conduct risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities associated with system interconnections and implement appropriate controls.
Ensure that all systems are configured securely and that security patches are applied regularly.
Establish monitoring mechanisms to detect unauthorized access or anomalies in system interactions.
Provide training for staff on the importance of securing interconnections and the specific policies in place.

controls.name: electronic commerce
controls.description: Information involved in electronic commerce passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute, and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

deployment_points.name: Implement SSL/TLS encryption for all transactions to secure data in transit over public networks.
Use secure payment gateways that comply with industry standards to process electronic payments.
Regularly audit and test the e-commerce platform for vulnerabilities and compliance with security standards.
Establish clear policies for handling customer data and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
Train employees on recognizing and preventing fraudulent activities related to electronic commerce.

controls.name: on-line transactions
controls.description: Information involved in on-line transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, mis-routing, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

deployment_points.name: Implement transaction validation mechanisms to ensure that all transactions are complete and accurate before processing.
Use encryption to protect transaction data during transmission to prevent unauthorized access and alteration.
Establish session management controls to prevent session hijacking and replay attacks.
Monitor transaction logs for unusual patterns that may indicate fraud or unauthorized access.
Provide user education on secure transaction practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.

controls.name: publicly available information
controls.description: The integrity of information being made available on a publicly available system shall be protected to prevent unauthorized modification.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict who can modify publicly available information.
Use version control systems to track changes made to publicly available information and facilitate rollback if necessary.
Regularly review and audit publicly available information for unauthorized changes or discrepancies.
Establish a process for reporting and responding to suspected unauthorized modifications.
Train staff on the importance of maintaining the integrity of publicly available information and the procedures in place.

controls.name: audit logging
controls.description: Audit logs recording user activities, exceptions, and information security events shall be produced and kept for an agreed period to assist in future investigations and access control monitoring.

deployment_points.name: Configure systems to generate detailed audit logs that capture user activities, access attempts, and security events.
Establish a retention policy for audit logs that complies with legal and regulatory requirements.
Regularly review audit logs for anomalies and potential security incidents.
Implement secure storage solutions for audit logs to prevent tampering and unauthorized access.
Train staff on the importance of audit logging and how to analyze logs for security monitoring.

controls.name: monitoring system use
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring use of information processing facilities shall be established and the results of the monitoring activities reviewed regularly.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document procedures for monitoring the use of information processing facilities, including user access and system performance.
Implement monitoring tools that provide real-time insights into system usage and potential security threats.
Schedule regular reviews of monitoring results to identify trends and address any issues promptly.
Ensure that monitoring activities comply with privacy regulations and organizational policies.
Train staff on the monitoring procedures and the importance of maintaining system security.

controls.name: protection of log information
controls.description: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict who can view and modify log information to authorized personnel only.
Use encryption to protect log data both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access.
Regularly audit logging facilities to ensure they are secure and functioning as intended.
Establish a backup procedure for log information to prevent data loss in case of system failure.
Train staff on the importance of log protection and the procedures in place to safeguard log information.

controls.name: administrator and operator control logs
controls.description: System administrator and system operator activities shall be logged.

deployment_points.name: Configure systems to automatically log all activities performed by system administrators and operators.
Ensure that logs include timestamps, user IDs, and details of actions taken for accountability.
Regularly review administrator and operator logs for unusual activities that may indicate security issues.
Implement secure storage for these logs to prevent tampering and unauthorized access.
Train system administrators and operators on the importance of logging their activities and the procedures in place.

controls.name: fault logging
controls.description: Faults shall be logged, analyzed, and appropriate action taken.

deployment_points.name: Implement a centralized logging system to capture all fault events across relevant systems.
Define the types of faults to be logged, including severity levels and categories for better analysis.
Establish a process for regularly reviewing and analyzing logged faults to identify trends and recurring issues.
Create a response plan that outlines actions to be taken for different types of faults, ensuring timely resolution.
Train staff on the importance of fault logging and the procedures for reporting and addressing faults.

controls.name: clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronized with an agreed accurate time source.

deployment_points.name: Identify and select a reliable time source, such as an NTP server, for synchronization across all systems.
Configure all relevant information processing systems to automatically synchronize their clocks with the chosen time source.
Establish a schedule for regular checks to ensure that all systems remain synchronized and address any discrepancies.
Document the synchronization process and any exceptions to ensure compliance and facilitate audits.
Train IT staff on the importance of clock synchronization and the procedures for troubleshooting synchronization issues.

controls.name: access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established, documented, and reviewed based on business and security requirements for access.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that outlines user roles, access levels, and responsibilities.
Document the policy and ensure it is easily accessible to all relevant stakeholders for review and compliance.
Schedule regular reviews of the access control policy to ensure it remains aligned with business and security requirements.
Implement a formal approval process for any changes to the access control policy to maintain integrity.
Train employees on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to established access protocols.

controls.name: user registration
controls.description: There shall be a formal user registration and de-registration procedure in place for granting and revoking access to all information systems and services.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal user registration process that includes identity verification and approval from management.
Create a de-registration procedure to revoke access promptly when users leave the organization or change roles.
Document all user registrations and de-registrations to maintain an accurate record of access rights.
Implement a system for periodic audits of user access to ensure compliance with registration and de-registration procedures.
Train staff on the user registration process and the importance of maintaining accurate access records.

controls.name: privilege management
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileges shall be restricted and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the different privilege levels required for various roles within the organization.
Implement a formal process for requesting, granting, and reviewing privileges to ensure they are appropriate.
Regularly audit privilege allocations to identify and revoke unnecessary or excessive privileges.
Establish a policy for monitoring the use of privileges to detect any unauthorized access or misuse.
Train employees on the principles of privilege management and the importance of adhering to established controls.

controls.name: user password management
controls.description: The allocation of passwords shall be controlled through a formal management process.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal password management policy that outlines password creation, complexity, and expiration requirements.
Implement a secure password management system to store and manage user passwords effectively.
Establish a process for users to reset forgotten passwords securely, ensuring identity verification.
Regularly review and update the password management policy to incorporate best practices and address emerging threats.
Train users on secure password practices and the importance of protecting their passwords.

controls.name: review of user access rights
controls.description: Management shall review usersΓÇÖ access rights at regular intervals using a formal process.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular reviews of user access rights, at least quarterly, to ensure they are appropriate for current roles.
Document the review process, including criteria for access rights and any changes made during the review.
Involve management in the review process to ensure accountability and oversight of access rights.
Implement a system for tracking changes to user access rights and maintaining an audit trail.
Train staff on the importance of regular access rights reviews and the procedures for conducting them.

controls.name: password use
controls.description: Users shall be required to follow good security practices in the selection and use of passwords.

deployment_points.name: Develop guidelines for creating strong passwords, including length, complexity, and uniqueness requirements.
Implement a password policy that mandates users to change passwords regularly and prohibits password sharing.
Provide training sessions for users on good password practices and the risks associated with weak passwords.
Monitor password usage and enforce compliance with the password policy through automated tools.
Establish a process for reporting and responding to suspected password breaches or compromises.

controls.name: unattended user equipment
controls.description: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

deployment_points.name: Implement a policy requiring users to lock their screens or log off when leaving equipment unattended.
Provide training to users on the importance of securing unattended equipment and the risks of leaving it exposed.
Install automatic screen lock features on all devices to enforce security when left idle.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the unattended equipment policy and address any violations.
Encourage a culture of security awareness where users feel responsible for protecting their equipment.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen policy
controls.description: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a clear desk and clear screen policy outlining expectations for maintaining a secure workspace.
Communicate the policy to all employees and provide training on its importance for information security.
Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with the clear desk and clear screen policy.
Provide secure storage options for sensitive documents and removable media to facilitate adherence to the policy.
Establish consequences for non-compliance to reinforce the importance of maintaining a secure environment.

controls.name: policy on use of network
controls.description: Deployment Points

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive network usage policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and consequences for violations.
Ensure the policy is communicated to all employees and stakeholders through training sessions and accessible documentation.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in technology, business needs, and regulatory requirements.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the policy, including audits and reporting procedures.
Establish a process for handling violations of the policy, including disciplinary actions and remediation steps.

controls.name: user authentication for external connections
controls.description: Appropriate authentication methods shall be used to control access by remote users.

deployment_points.name: Identify and implement strong authentication methods such as multi-factor authentication (MFA) for remote access.
Ensure that all remote access points are secured with encryption protocols to protect user credentials during transmission.
Regularly review and update authentication methods to incorporate advancements in security technology and best practices.
Provide training for users on secure authentication practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.
Monitor and log remote access attempts to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts promptly.

controls.name: equipment identification in networks
controls.description: Automatic equipment identification shall be considered as a means to authenticate connections from specific locations and equipment.

deployment_points.name: Implement automatic equipment identification systems that can recognize and authenticate devices connecting to the network.
Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all authorized devices and their corresponding identification parameters.
Configure network access controls to allow only recognized devices to connect, blocking unauthorized equipment.
Regularly audit the equipment identification system to ensure its effectiveness and update it as necessary.
Train IT staff on the importance of equipment identification and the procedures for managing device access.

controls.name: remote diagnostic and configuration port protection
controls.description: Physical and logical access to diagnostic and configuration ports shall be controlled.

deployment_points.name: Restrict physical access to diagnostic and configuration ports to authorized personnel only, using locks or access control systems.
Implement logical access controls, such as password protection and user authentication, for remote access to these ports.
Regularly review and update access permissions to ensure only necessary personnel have access to configuration settings.
Monitor and log all access attempts to diagnostic and configuration ports to detect any unauthorized access.
Provide training for personnel on the importance of securing diagnostic and configuration ports and the potential risks of unauthorized access.

controls.name: segregation in networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

deployment_points.name: Design the network architecture to create separate segments for different groups of users and information services based on their security requirements.
Implement firewalls and access control lists (ACLs) to enforce segregation between network segments.
Regularly review and update network segmentation to adapt to changes in organizational structure and security needs.
Monitor traffic between segments to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.
Train staff on the importance of network segregation and the procedures for maintaining secure network boundaries.

controls.name: network connection control
controls.description: For shared networks, especially those extending across the organizationΓÇÖs boundaries, the capability of users to connect to the network shall be restricted, in line with the access control policy and requirements of the business applications.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the access control policy that specifies who can connect to the network and under what conditions.
Implement technical controls such as VPNs and firewalls to enforce the access control policy for network connections.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure compliance with the access control policy and adjust as necessary.
Monitor network connections to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts in real-time.
Provide training for users on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to connection restrictions.

controls.name: network routing control
controls.description: Routing controls shall be implemented for networks to ensure that computer connections and information flows do not breach the access control policy of the business applications.

deployment_points.name: Configure routing protocols and devices to enforce the access control policy and prevent unauthorized information flows.
Regularly review and update routing configurations to adapt to changes in network architecture and security requirements.
Implement monitoring tools to track and log routing activities for compliance and security analysis.
Conduct periodic audits of routing controls to ensure they are functioning as intended and identify any vulnerabilities.
Train network administrators on best practices for routing control and the importance of adhering to access control policies.

controls.name: secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Access to operating systems shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

deployment_points.name: Implement secure log-on procedures that require strong authentication methods, such as passwords or biometrics.
Ensure that log-on procedures are enforced across all operating systems and devices within the organization.
Regularly review and update log-on procedures to incorporate new security technologies and best practices.
Monitor log-on attempts and establish alerts for suspicious activities or repeated failed attempts.
Provide training for users on secure log-on practices and the importance of protecting their credentials.

controls.name: user identification and authentication
controls.description: All users shall have a unique identifier (user ID) for their personal use only, and a suitable authentication technique shall be chosen to substantiate the claimed identity of a user.

deployment_points.name: Assign unique user IDs to all users, ensuring that these identifiers are not shared or reused.
Implement strong authentication techniques, such as multi-factor authentication, to verify user identities.
Regularly review user accounts and authentication methods to ensure compliance with security policies.
Monitor user activity to detect any unauthorized access or misuse of user IDs.
Provide training for users on the importance of unique identifiers and secure authentication practices.

controls.name: password management system
controls.description: Systems for managing passwords shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

deployment_points.name: Implement an interactive password management system that enforces strong password policies, including complexity and length requirements.
Provide users with guidance on creating secure passwords and the importance of password uniqueness.
Regularly review and update the password management system to incorporate best practices and address emerging threats.
Monitor password usage and implement alerts for suspicious activities, such as multiple failed login attempts.
Train users on the importance of password security and the proper use of the password management system.

controls.name: use of system utilities
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all system utilities that have the potential to override system and application controls.
Establish a list of approved utilities and ensure that only these are accessible to users.
Implement role-based access controls to restrict the use of utilities based on user roles and responsibilities.
Regularly review and audit the usage of system utilities to ensure compliance with the established policies.
Provide training to users on the risks associated with unauthorized use of system utilities.

controls.name: session time-out
controls.description: Inactive sessions shall shut down after a defined period of inactivity.
