Configure application and system settings to enforce automatic session time-out based on the defined period.
Communicate the session time-out policy to all users to ensure awareness and compliance.
Implement a warning message to notify users before their session is terminated due to inactivity.
Regularly test and review the session time-out functionality to ensure it is working as intended.

controls.name: limitation of connection time
controls.description: Restrictions on connection times shall be used to provide additional security for high-risk applications.

deployment_points.name: Identify high-risk applications that require connection time restrictions.
Define specific connection time windows during which access to these applications is permitted.
Configure access controls to enforce connection time limitations based on the defined schedule.
Monitor and log access attempts outside of the allowed connection times for auditing purposes.
Review and update connection time policies regularly to adapt to changing security needs.

controls.name: information access
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions by users and support personnel shall be restricted in accordance with the defined access control policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that defines user roles and access levels.
Implement role-based access controls (RBAC) to restrict access to information and system functions based on user roles.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure they align with current job responsibilities.
Provide training to users on the importance of adhering to access control policies.
Conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with the access control policy.

controls.name: sensitive system isolation
controls.description: Sensitive systems shall have a dedicated (isolated) computing environment.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive systems that require isolation from other computing environments.
Establish a dedicated computing environment for these sensitive systems, ensuring physical and logical separation.
Implement strict access controls to limit who can access the isolated environment.
Regularly assess the security of the isolated environment to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
Document and maintain policies governing the use and access of the isolated computing environment.

controls.name: mobile computing and communications
controls.description: A formal policy shall be in place, and appropriate security measures shall be adopted to protect against the risks of using mobile computing and communication facilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal mobile computing and communications policy that outlines security requirements and acceptable use.
Implement security measures such as encryption, remote wipe capabilities, and secure access protocols for mobile devices.
Train employees on the risks associated with mobile computing and the importance of following the policy.
Regularly review and update the mobile computing policy to address emerging threats and technologies.
Monitor mobile device usage and compliance with the policy through audits and reporting.

controls.name: teleworking
controls.description: A policy, operational plans and procedures shall be developed and implemented for teleworking activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a teleworking policy that outlines security requirements, acceptable use, and responsibilities of teleworkers.
Implement secure remote access solutions, such as VPNs, to protect data transmitted during teleworking.
Provide training to teleworkers on security best practices and the importance of adhering to the teleworking policy.
Regularly review and update teleworking procedures to ensure they remain effective and relevant.
Monitor teleworking activities to ensure compliance with the established policy and procedures.

controls.name: security requirements
controls.description: Statements of business requirements for new information systems, analysis and specification or enhancements to existing information systems shall specify the requirements for security controls.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for documenting security requirements as part of the business requirements for new and existing information systems.
Involve security personnel in the requirements gathering phase to ensure comprehensive coverage of security controls.
Review and validate security requirements with stakeholders to ensure they meet business and compliance needs.
Integrate security requirements into the system development lifecycle (SDLC) to ensure they are addressed throughout the project.
Regularly review and update security requirements to adapt to changes in technology and threat landscape.

controls.name: input data validation
controls.description: Data input to applications shall be validated to ensure that this data is correct and appropriate.

deployment_points.name: Define validation rules for all data inputs based on business requirements and data types.
Implement input validation checks within applications to ensure data integrity and correctness.
Conduct testing to verify that validation mechanisms are functioning as intended.
Provide training to developers on best practices for input data validation to prevent vulnerabilities.
Regularly review and update validation rules to address new data types and potential threats.

controls.name: control of internal processing
controls.description: Validation checks shall be incorporated into applications to detect any corruption of information through processing errors or deliberate acts.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical processing functions within applications that require validation checks.
Implement validation checks to monitor data integrity during processing and flag any anomalies.
Conduct regular testing of validation mechanisms to ensure they effectively detect processing errors.
Document and maintain procedures for handling detected anomalies and corruption incidents.
Review and update validation checks periodically to adapt to changes in processing logic and threats.

controls.name: message integrity
controls.description: Requirements for ensuring authenticity and protecting message integrity in applications shall be identified, and appropriate controls identified and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of messages that require integrity protection within the application.
Implement cryptographic techniques such as hashing or digital signatures to ensure message authenticity.
Establish procedures for verifying message integrity at both the sender and receiver ends.
Regularly review and update the integrity controls to adapt to new threats and vulnerabilities.
Train personnel on the importance of message integrity and the specific controls in place.

controls.name: output data validation
controls.description: Data output from an application shall be validated to ensure that the processing of stored information is correct and appropriate to the circumstances.

deployment_points.name: Define validation criteria based on the expected output format and data types.
Implement automated validation checks within the application to verify output data against the defined criteria.
Establish a review process for manual validation of critical outputs that cannot be automated.
Document and log validation results to maintain an audit trail for compliance and troubleshooting.
Regularly test and update validation rules to ensure they remain effective against evolving data processing requirements.

controls.name: policy on the use of cryptographic controls
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive policy outlining the types of cryptographic controls to be used and their purposes.
Ensure the policy includes guidelines for key management, encryption standards, and usage scenarios.
Communicate the policy to all relevant stakeholders and provide training on its implementation.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in technology and regulatory requirements.
Monitor compliance with the policy and enforce disciplinary measures for violations.

controls.name: key management
controls.description: Key management shall be in place to support the organizationΓÇÖs use of cryptographic techniques.

deployment_points.name: Establish a key management policy that defines roles, responsibilities, and procedures for key generation, distribution, and storage.

Maintain an inventory of all cryptographic keys and their usage to facilitate audits and compliance checks.
Train staff on key management practices and the importance of safeguarding cryptographic keys.

controls.name: control of operational software
controls.description: There shall be procedures in place to control the installation of software on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document procedures for the approval and installation of software on operational systems.
Implement a change management system to track software installations and modifications.
Restrict installation privileges to authorized personnel only to prevent unauthorized software changes.
Regularly audit installed software to ensure compliance with the established procedures.
Provide training for staff on the importance of software control and the procedures in place.

controls.name: protection of system test data
controls.description: Test data shall be selected carefully, and protected and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify test data based on sensitivity and relevance to testing scenarios.
Implement access controls to restrict who can view and use test data.
Use anonymization or pseudonymization techniques to protect sensitive information in test data.
Regularly review and update test data protection measures to ensure they are effective.
Train personnel on the importance of protecting test data and the specific controls in place.

controls.name: access control to program source code
controls.description: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can access program source code and under what conditions.
Implement role-based access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can view or modify source code.
Use version control systems to track changes to source code and maintain an audit trail.
Regularly review access permissions to ensure they align with current roles and responsibilities.
Provide training for developers on secure coding practices and the importance of source code protection.

controls.name: change control procedures
controls.description: The implementation of changes shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop formal change control procedures that outline the steps for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes.
Implement a change request system to document and track all proposed changes.
Establish a change advisory board to review and approve significant changes before implementation.
Conduct impact assessments for changes to evaluate potential risks and effects on operations.
Train staff on the change control process and the importance of adhering to established procedures.

controls.name: technical review of applications after operating system changes
controls.description: When operating systems are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

deployment_points.name: Establish a review process for assessing the impact of operating system changes on critical applications.
Create a checklist of key areas to evaluate during the review, including functionality, performance, and security.
Conduct thorough testing of applications in a controlled environment after operating system changes.
Document the results of the review and testing to provide evidence of compliance and due diligence.
Communicate findings to relevant stakeholders and implement necessary adjustments based on the review.

controls.name: restrictions on changes to software packages
controls.description: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes, and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy that outlines the restrictions and procedures for modifying software packages.
Implement a formal approval process for any necessary changes to software packages.
Maintain documentation of all changes made to software packages, including the rationale and approval.
Regularly review and audit changes to ensure compliance with the established restrictions.
Train staff on the importance of adhering to the restrictions and the potential risks of unauthorized changes.

controls.name: prevent information leakage
controls.description: Opportunities for information leakage shall be prevented.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough assessment of all information systems to identify potential leakage points, such as unsecured data storage or transmission methods.
Implement data loss prevention (DLP) technologies to monitor and control data transfers, ensuring sensitive information is not transmitted outside the organization without authorization.
Establish strict access controls and permissions to limit who can view or handle sensitive information, ensuring only authorized personnel have access.

Regularly train employees on the importance of information security and the specific measures in place to prevent information leakage, including recognizing phishing attempts and secure data handling practices.
Continuously monitor and review information systems for compliance with leakage prevention policies, making adjustments as necessary based on emerging threats or vulnerabilities.

controls.name: supervise outsourced software development
controls.description: Outsourced software development shall be supervised and monitored by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear contracts with outsourced developers that outline security requirements, including compliance with organizational policies and standards.
Implement regular progress reviews and audits of the outsourced development process to ensure adherence to security protocols and project specifications.
Designate a liaison within the organization to maintain communication with the outsourced team, facilitating oversight and addressing any security concerns promptly.
Require the outsourced team to follow secure coding practices and conduct security testing on all software components before deployment.
Document all findings from supervision activities and maintain a record of compliance to ensure accountability and facilitate future assessments.

controls.name: address technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Timely information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

deployment_points.name: Subscribe to vulnerability databases and threat intelligence services to receive timely updates on known vulnerabilities affecting the organization's systems.
Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify and evaluate the organization's exposure to potential threats.
Prioritize identified vulnerabilities based on their severity and potential impact on the organization, developing a remediation plan for high-risk issues.
Implement patches and updates for software and systems promptly, ensuring that all known vulnerabilities are addressed in a timely manner.
Maintain documentation of vulnerability assessments, remediation efforts, and ongoing monitoring activities to ensure compliance and facilitate future evaluations.

controls.name: report information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

deployment_points.name: Establish a clear reporting protocol that outlines the steps employees must take to report information security events, including who to contact and how to document the event.
Train all employees on the importance of timely reporting and the specific types of events that should be reported, such as breaches or suspicious activities.
Implement a centralized reporting system that allows for easy submission and tracking of security events, ensuring that all reports are logged and monitored.
Designate a response team responsible for reviewing reported events and determining the appropriate course of action, including escalation procedures.
Regularly review and update the reporting protocol to incorporate lessons learned from past incidents and ensure it remains effective and relevant.

controls.name: report security weaknesses
controls.description: All employees, contractors and third party users of information systems and services shall be required to note and report any observed or suspected security weaknesses in systems or services.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate a clear policy that mandates the reporting of security weaknesses, detailing the types of weaknesses to report and the reporting process.
Provide training sessions for all employees, contractors, and third-party users to raise awareness about common security weaknesses and the importance of reporting them.
Create an accessible reporting mechanism, such as a dedicated email address or online form, to facilitate the submission of security weakness reports.
Establish a review process for reported weaknesses, ensuring that they are assessed and addressed in a timely manner by the appropriate personnel.
Encourage a culture of security awareness by recognizing and rewarding individuals who report security weaknesses, reinforcing the importance of proactive security measures.

controls.name: establish incident response procedures
controls.description: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective, and orderly response to information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive incident response plan that outlines roles, responsibilities, and procedures for responding to various types of information security incidents.
Assign specific roles to team members, ensuring that everyone understands their responsibilities during an incident and the chain of command.
Conduct regular training and simulation exercises to prepare the incident response team and other relevant staff for real-world scenarios.
Establish communication protocols for internal and external stakeholders during an incident, ensuring timely and accurate information dissemination.
Review and update the incident response plan regularly based on lessons learned from past incidents and changes in the threat landscape.

controls.name: learn from information security incidents
controls.description: There shall be mechanisms in place to enable the types, volumes, and costs of information security incidents to be quantified and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Implement a tracking system to log all information security incidents, capturing details such as type, volume, cost, and response actions taken.
Conduct post-incident reviews to analyze the causes and impacts of security incidents, identifying areas for improvement in processes and controls.
Develop metrics to quantify the frequency and severity of incidents, providing insights into trends and potential vulnerabilities.
Share findings from incident analyses with relevant stakeholders to promote awareness and drive improvements in security practices across the organization.
Regularly report on incident statistics and lessons learned to management, ensuring that the organization remains informed and proactive in addressing security challenges.

controls.name: collect evidence for legal action
controls.description: Where a follow-up action against a person or organization after an information security incident involves legal action (either civil or criminal), evidence shall be collected, retained, and presented to conform to the rules for evidence laid down in the relevant jurisdiction(s).

deployment_points.name: Establish clear procedures for collecting and preserving evidence following an information security incident, ensuring compliance with legal standards.
Train incident response team members on proper evidence collection techniques, including chain of custody and documentation practices.
Designate a secure location for storing collected evidence to prevent tampering or loss, ensuring access is restricted to authorized personnel only.
Collaborate with legal counsel to ensure that evidence collection processes align with applicable laws and regulations in the relevant jurisdictions.
Regularly review and update evidence collection procedures based on legal developments and lessons learned from past incidents.

controls_data.name: Including Information Security In The Business Continuity Management Process

controls.name: include information security in business continuity
controls.description: A managed process shall be developed and maintained for business continuity throughout the organization that addresses the information security requirements needed for the organizationΓÇÖs business continuity.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security considerations into the organization's overall business continuity planning process, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential threats to business continuity and their impact on information security, developing strategies to mitigate these risks.
Develop and document business continuity plans that include specific information security measures, such as data backup and recovery procedures.
Regularly test and update business continuity plans to ensure their effectiveness and relevance in the face of changing threats and business conditions.
Train employees on their roles in the business continuity plan, emphasizing the importance of information security in maintaining operational resilience.

controls.name: conduct business continuity risk assessment
controls.description: Events that can cause interruptions to business processes shall be identified, along with the probability and impact of such interruptions and their consequences for information security.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical business processes and the potential events that could disrupt them, such as natural disasters, cyberattacks, or system failures.
Assess the likelihood and potential impact of identified events on business operations and information security, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
Develop a risk matrix to prioritize identified risks based on their probability and impact, guiding resource allocation for mitigation efforts.
Document findings from the risk assessment, including recommendations for risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Review and update the risk assessment regularly to reflect changes in the business environment, emerging threats, and lessons learned from past incidents.

controls.name: develop continuity plans
controls.description: Plans shall be developed and implemented to maintain or restore operations and ensure availability of information at the required level and in the required time scales following interruption to, or failure of, critical business processes.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical business processes and the information required to support them, ensuring all stakeholders are involved in the planning process.
Develop detailed continuity plans that outline specific actions to be taken in the event of an interruption, including roles and responsibilities.
Implement the plans by training staff and ensuring that resources are allocated for effective execution during a disruption.
Regularly review and update the plans to reflect changes in business processes, technology, and regulatory requirements.
Establish a communication strategy to inform all relevant parties about the continuity plans and their roles in the event of an incident.

controls.name: maintain business continuity planning framework
controls.description: A single framework of business continuity plans shall be maintained to ensure all plans are consistent, to consistently address information security requirements, and to identify priorities for testing and maintenance.

deployment_points.name: Create a centralized repository for all business continuity plans to ensure easy access and consistency across the organization.
Establish a governance structure to oversee the maintenance of the framework, including regular reviews and updates of all plans.
Ensure that all business continuity plans are aligned with information security requirements and best practices.
Develop a schedule for regular testing and maintenance of the plans to ensure their effectiveness and relevance.
Communicate the framework to all employees and provide training on their roles within the business continuity plans.

controls.name: test and maintain business continuity plans
controls.description: Business continuity plans shall be tested and updated regularly to ensure that they are up to date and effective.

deployment_points.name: Develop a testing schedule that includes various scenarios to evaluate the effectiveness of the business continuity plans.
Conduct regular drills and simulations to assess the readiness of staff and the functionality of the plans.
Gather feedback from participants after each test to identify areas for improvement and update the plans accordingly.
Document all test results and updates to ensure a clear record of the plans' effectiveness over time.
Review and revise the plans at least annually or after significant changes to the business environment or processes.

controls.name: identify applicable legislation
controls.description: All relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements and the organizationΓÇÖs approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly defined, documented, and kept up to date for each information system and the organization.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive review of all applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations relevant to the organizationΓÇÖs information systems.
Document the identified requirements in a centralized compliance register that is easily accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Assign responsibility for monitoring changes in legislation to ensure ongoing compliance and timely updates to the documentation.
Train staff on the importance of compliance and the specific requirements that apply to their roles and responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the compliance register to reflect any changes in legislation or organizational practices.

controls.name: ensure compliance with intellectual property rights
controls.description: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements on the use of material in respect of which there may be intellectual property rights and on the use of proprietary software products.

deployment_points.name: Develop and implement policies that clearly outline the organizationΓÇÖs approach to intellectual property rights compliance.
Conduct training sessions for employees on the importance of intellectual property rights and the specific procedures to follow.
Establish a process for reviewing and approving the use of third-party materials and proprietary software to ensure compliance.
Monitor and audit the use of intellectual property within the organization to identify and address any potential violations.
Maintain documentation of all compliance efforts and any incidents related to intellectual property rights for future reference.

controls.name: protect organizational records
controls.description: Important records shall be protected from loss, destruction and falsification, in accordance with statutory, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify all organizational records based on their importance and the level of protection required.
Implement access controls to restrict unauthorized access to sensitive records and ensure only authorized personnel can modify them.
Establish backup procedures to regularly create copies of important records and store them securely offsite.
Develop and enforce policies for the proper handling, storage, and disposal of records to prevent loss or destruction.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with record protection policies and to identify any vulnerabilities.

controls.name: data protection and privacy of personal information
controls.description: Data protection and privacy shall be ensured as required in relevant legislation, regulations, and, if applicable, contractual clauses.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a data inventory to identify all personal information held by the organization and assess its sensitivity.
Develop and implement data protection policies that comply with relevant legislation and regulations regarding personal information.
Train employees on data protection principles and their responsibilities in handling personal information.
Implement technical measures such as encryption and access controls to protect personal information from unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update data protection practices to ensure ongoing compliance with changing laws and regulations.

controls.name: prevention of misuse of information processing facilities
controls.description: Users shall be deterred from using information processing facilities for unauthorized purposes.

deployment_points.name: Develop and communicate clear policies regarding acceptable use of information processing facilities to all users.
Implement technical controls such as user authentication and monitoring to detect and prevent unauthorized access.
Conduct regular training sessions to educate users about the risks and consequences of misuse of information processing facilities.
Establish a reporting mechanism for users to report suspected misuse or security incidents related to information processing facilities.
Regularly review and update policies and controls to adapt to new threats and ensure ongoing effectiveness.

controls.name: regulation of cryptographic controls
controls.description: Cryptographic controls shall be used in compliance with all relevant agreements, laws, and regulations.

deployment_points.name: Identify all cryptographic controls currently in use and assess their compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
Develop a policy that outlines the acceptable use of cryptographic controls within the organization.
Train employees on the importance of cryptographic controls and the specific regulations that apply to their use.
Implement technical measures to ensure that cryptographic controls are applied consistently across all relevant systems and data.
Regularly review and update cryptographic practices to ensure compliance with evolving legal and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: compliance with security policies and standards
controls.description: Managers shall ensure that all security procedures within their area of responsibility are carried out correctly to achieve compliance with security policies and standards.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive set of security policies and standards that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
Assign specific responsibilities to managers for overseeing compliance with security policies within their teams.
Conduct regular training sessions to ensure that all employees understand the security policies and their importance.
Implement monitoring and reporting mechanisms to track compliance and identify areas for improvement.
Review and update security policies and standards regularly to reflect changes in the organizational environment and emerging threats.

controls.name: technical compliance checking
controls.description: Information systems shall be regularly checked for compliance with security implementation standards.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular compliance checks of information systems to ensure adherence to security standards.
Develop a checklist based on the security implementation standards that need to be verified during each compliance check.
Assign qualified personnel to conduct the compliance checks and provide them with necessary training on the standards.
Document the findings of each compliance check, including any non-compliance issues and corrective actions taken.
Review and update the compliance checking process periodically to incorporate changes in security standards and improve effectiveness.

controls.name: information systems audit
controls.description: Audit requirements and activities involving checks on operational systems shall be carefully planned and agreed to minimize the risk of disruptions to business processes.

deployment_points.name: Define the scope and objectives of the audit, ensuring alignment with business processes and operational requirements.
Create a detailed audit plan that outlines the timeline, resources, and methodologies to be used during the audit.
Communicate the audit plan to all relevant stakeholders to gain their agreement and minimize disruptions.
Conduct the audit according to the plan, ensuring that all activities are documented and any issues are reported promptly.
After the audit, hold a debriefing session with stakeholders to discuss findings and agree on necessary actions to address any identified issues.

controls.name: protection of information systems audit tools
controls.description: Access to information systems audit tools shall be protected to prevent any possible misuse or compromise.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict the use of audit tools to authorized personnel only, using role-based access management.
Regularly review and update the list of authorized users to ensure that only current personnel have access to the audit tools.
Provide training to authorized users on the proper use and handling of audit tools to prevent misuse.
Monitor the usage of audit tools to detect any unauthorized access attempts or suspicious activities.
Establish a procedure for reporting and responding to any incidents of misuse or compromise of the audit tools.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

deployment_points.name: Define a comprehensive set of information security policies that cover all relevant aspects of security management.
Obtain formal approval of the policies from senior management to ensure organizational commitment.
Publish the approved policies in accessible formats and locations for all employees and relevant external parties.
Conduct training sessions to communicate the policies effectively to all stakeholders, ensuring understanding and compliance.
Establish a process for ongoing communication regarding policy updates and changes to maintain awareness.

controls.name: review of the policies for information security
controls.description: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular review intervals for the information security policies, such as annually or bi-annually.
Identify triggers for unscheduled reviews, such as significant organizational changes or security incidents.
Assemble a review team that includes stakeholders from various departments to assess the policies' effectiveness.
Document the findings of each review and make necessary updates to the policies based on the assessment.
Communicate any changes made to the policies to all employees and relevant external parties promptly.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

deployment_points.name: Identify all roles within the organization that have responsibilities related to information security.
Clearly define the specific security responsibilities associated with each role to avoid ambiguity.
Document the roles and responsibilities in an accessible format and distribute it to all relevant personnel.
Ensure that all employees receive training on their specific information security responsibilities and the importance of compliance.
Regularly review and update the roles and responsibilities to reflect changes in the organization or security landscape.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organizationΓÇÖs assets.

deployment_points.name: Identify key processes within the organization that require segregation of duties to mitigate risks.
Define and document the specific roles involved in each process to ensure clear separation of responsibilities.
Implement access controls that enforce the segregation of duties, preventing unauthorized access to conflicting roles.
Regularly audit processes to ensure compliance with segregation of duties and identify any potential violations.
Provide training to employees on the importance of segregation of duties and the risks associated with non-compliance.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities and regulatory bodies that the organization must maintain contact with for compliance and security purposes.
Designate specific personnel responsible for managing relationships with these authorities.
Establish a communication plan that outlines how and when to engage with authorities, including reporting requirements.
Document all interactions with authorities to maintain a record of communications and compliance efforts.
Regularly review and update the list of authorities and the communication plan to ensure relevance and effectiveness.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups and professional associations related to information security.
Designate personnel to represent the organization in these groups and forums to facilitate knowledge sharing.
Establish a schedule for regular participation in meetings, conferences, and discussions hosted by these groups.
Document insights and best practices gained from participation and share them with relevant internal stakeholders.
Regularly assess the value of the contacts maintained and adjust participation as necessary to align with organizational goals.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be addressed in project management, regardless of the type of the project.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security requirements into the project management framework and processes from the outset.
Conduct risk assessments for each project to identify potential security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.
Assign specific information security roles within project teams to ensure accountability and oversight.
Document security considerations and decisions made throughout the project lifecycle for future reference.
Review and evaluate the effectiveness of security measures implemented in completed projects to inform future practices.

controls.name: mobile device policy
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile devices.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive mobile device policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and responsibilities.
Implement technical controls such as encryption and remote wipe capabilities for all mobile devices used within the organization.
Provide training to employees on the mobile device policy and best practices for securing their devices.
Regularly review and update the mobile device policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor compliance with the mobile device policy and take corrective actions as necessary to enforce adherence.

controls.name: teleworking
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

deployment_points.name: Create a teleworking policy that defines security requirements for remote work, including data protection and device security.
Implement secure access methods, such as VPNs, to protect data transmitted between teleworking sites and the organization.
Provide employees with training on the teleworking policy and secure practices for handling sensitive information remotely.
Regularly assess the security measures in place for teleworking to identify and address potential vulnerabilities.
Establish a process for reporting security incidents that occur during teleworking to ensure timely response and mitigation.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

deployment_points.name: Develop a screening policy that outlines the types of background checks to be conducted based on role and information sensitivity.
Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations regarding background checks and candidate privacy.
Implement a standardized process for conducting background checks, including documentation and record-keeping.
Train HR personnel on the screening policy and the importance of conducting thorough checks for security purposes.
Regularly review and update the screening policy to reflect changes in legal requirements and organizational needs.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The contractual agreements with employees and contractors shall state their and the organizationΓÇÖs responsibilities for information security.

deployment_points.name: Draft clear contractual agreements that outline the responsibilities of both the organization and the employees regarding information security.
Ensure that all contracts include specific clauses related to data protection, confidentiality, and compliance with security policies.
Review and update contracts regularly to reflect changes in laws, regulations, and organizational policies.
Communicate the importance of these terms to employees during onboarding and provide training on their implications.
Maintain a record of all signed agreements and ensure they are accessible for reference and compliance audits.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate clear information security policies and procedures that outline expectations for all employees and contractors.
Conduct regular training sessions to ensure that all staff understand their responsibilities regarding information security.
Implement a system for management to monitor compliance with these policies and take corrective actions when necessary.
Establish a culture of accountability where management leads by example in adhering to security practices.
Regularly review and update policies to address emerging threats and changes in the organizational environment.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive training program that covers information security awareness tailored to different job functions.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to keep employees informed about the latest security threats and organizational policies.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to engage employees effectively.
Track attendance and completion of training programs to ensure all employees meet the required standards.
Solicit feedback from participants to continuously improve the training content and delivery methods.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: There shall be a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who have committed an information security breach.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal disciplinary policy that outlines the procedures for addressing information security breaches.
Communicate the disciplinary process to all employees during onboarding and through regular training sessions.
Ensure that the policy includes clear definitions of breaches and the corresponding consequences.
Establish a review board or committee to handle disciplinary actions fairly and consistently.
Document all disciplinary actions taken and maintain records for compliance and future reference.

controls.name: termination or change of employment responsibilities
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor and enforced.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the information security responsibilities that persist after employment termination or role changes.
Communicate these responsibilities clearly to employees during their exit interviews or role transition meetings.
Implement a process to revoke access to systems and data immediately upon termination or change of employment.
Ensure that employees acknowledge their ongoing responsibilities in writing as part of the termination process.
Regularly review and update the policies to ensure they remain relevant and enforceable.

controls.name: inventory of assets
controls.description: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive assessment to identify all information assets and processing facilities within the organization.
Create and maintain an up-to-date inventory that includes details such as asset type, owner, location, and classification.
Implement a regular review process to ensure the inventory reflects any changes in asset status or ownership.
Utilize asset management software to streamline the tracking and management of information assets.
Ensure that all employees are aware of the importance of asset management and their role in maintaining the inventory.

controls.name: ownership of assets
controls.description: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

deployment_points.name: Assign clear ownership for each asset listed in the inventory to specific individuals or departments.
Document the responsibilities of asset owners regarding the protection and management of their assigned assets.
Conduct regular reviews to ensure that asset ownership is current and accurately reflected in the inventory.
Provide training to asset owners on their responsibilities and the importance of information security.
Establish a process for transferring ownership when employees leave or change roles within the organization.

controls.name: acceptable use of assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear acceptable use policy that outlines the rules for using organizational information and assets.
Communicate the policy to all employees and contractors during onboarding and through regular training sessions.
Ensure that the policy is easily accessible and regularly reviewed for relevance and clarity.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the acceptable use policy.
Establish consequences for violations of the policy to reinforce the importance of adherence.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal process for the return of organizational assets upon termination or contract completion.
Communicate the asset return policy to employees and external users during onboarding and exit procedures.
Create a checklist of assets that must be returned, including equipment, documents, and access credentials.
Assign responsibility for overseeing the return process to a designated individual or team.
Document the return of assets and maintain records for compliance and auditing purposes.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes information based on legal, business, and security requirements.
Train employees on the classification criteria and the importance of properly classifying information.
Implement a process for regularly reviewing and updating information classifications as needed.
Ensure that all classified information is marked appropriately and handled according to its classification level.
Establish access controls based on information classification to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information classification scheme that defines categories and sensitivity levels for all types of information.
Create labelling procedures that specify how information should be marked based on its classification, including visual labels and metadata.
Train employees on the importance of information labelling and the procedures to follow for consistent application across the organization.
Implement a review process to ensure that information is labelled correctly and consistently, with periodic audits to verify compliance.
Establish a mechanism for updating labels as information changes in classification or sensitivity, ensuring that all stakeholders are informed.

controls.name: handling of assets
controls.description: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Define handling procedures for each asset type based on its classification, including guidelines for storage, access, and transfer.
Train staff on the proper handling procedures for assets, emphasizing the importance of following the classification scheme.
Implement access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can handle sensitive assets, with clear documentation of access rights.
Monitor and log all asset handling activities to ensure compliance with established procedures and to identify any unauthorized actions.
Regularly review and update handling procedures to reflect changes in the classification scheme or organizational policies.

controls.name: management of removable media
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish a policy for the use of removable media that outlines acceptable types, usage scenarios, and security measures based on classification.
Implement encryption and access controls for all removable media to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.
Train employees on the risks associated with removable media and the procedures for secure usage and storage.
Maintain an inventory of all removable media, including tracking their usage and ensuring they are returned or disposed of securely.
Regularly audit the management of removable media to ensure compliance with established procedures and to identify potential security gaps.

controls.name: disposal of media
controls.description: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal disposal policy that outlines the methods for securely disposing of different types of media based on their classification.
Implement procedures for the physical destruction or secure wiping of media to ensure that sensitive information cannot be recovered.
Train staff on the importance of secure media disposal and the specific procedures to follow when disposing of media.
Maintain records of disposed media, including the method of disposal and the personnel involved, to ensure accountability.
Regularly review and update disposal procedures to incorporate new technologies and best practices for secure media disposal.

controls.name: physical media transfer
controls.description: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation.

deployment_points.name: Establish a policy for the secure transfer of physical media that includes guidelines for packaging, labeling, and transportation methods.
Implement encryption and secure transport methods for sensitive media to protect against unauthorized access during transit.
Train employees on the procedures for securely transferring media, including the importance of maintaining confidentiality and integrity.
Monitor and document all transfers of physical media, including the individuals involved and the conditions of transport.
Regularly review and update transfer procedures to address any identified risks or changes in technology.

controls.name: access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established, documented and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that outlines the principles, roles, and responsibilities for access management within the organization.
Document the policy and ensure it is easily accessible to all employees, with clear guidelines on how to request and manage access.
Conduct regular reviews of the access control policy to ensure it remains aligned with business needs and security requirements.
Train employees on the access control policy, emphasizing the importance of compliance and the potential risks of unauthorized access.
Implement a mechanism for monitoring and enforcing the access control policy, including regular audits and reporting of access violations.

controls.name: access to networks and network services
controls.description: Users shall only be provided with access to the network and network services that they have been specifically authorized to use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for granting access to network services that includes verification of user identity and authorization levels.
Implement role-based access controls to ensure users only have access to the services necessary for their job functions.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure they remain appropriate and revoke access for users who no longer require it.
Train employees on the importance of adhering to access restrictions and the procedures for requesting additional access if needed.
Monitor network access logs to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts or anomalies.

controls.name: user registration and de-registration
controls.description: A formal user registration and de-registration process shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal user registration process that includes identity verification and documentation of user roles and access needs.
Implement a de-registration process to ensure that access rights are revoked promptly when users leave the organization or change roles.
Train staff responsible for user registration and de-registration on the procedures and the importance of maintaining accurate access records.
Maintain a centralized database of user access rights to facilitate monitoring and auditing of user accounts.
Regularly review and update the registration and de-registration processes to ensure they remain effective and compliant with security policies.

controls.name: user access provisioning
controls.description: A formal user access provisioning process shall be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal access provisioning process that includes criteria for assigning access rights based on user roles and responsibilities.
Implement automated tools to streamline the provisioning process and ensure timely assignment and revocation of access rights.
Train personnel involved in access provisioning on the procedures and the importance of adhering to the established criteria.
Maintain detailed records of all access provisioning activities to facilitate audits and compliance checks.
Regularly review and update the access provisioning process to incorporate feedback and address any identified issues.

controls.name: management of privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for managing privileged access rights that defines who is eligible for such access and under what circumstances.
Implement strict controls and monitoring for the allocation and use of privileged access rights to prevent abuse.
Train users with privileged access on their responsibilities and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.
Conduct regular audits of privileged access rights to ensure compliance with the policy and to identify any unauthorized access.
Establish a process for revoking privileged access promptly when it is no longer needed or when a user changes roles.

controls.name: management of secret authentication information of users
controls.description: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for the allocation and management of secret authentication information, including roles and responsibilities.
Implement a secure method for generating and distributing secret authentication information to users.
Maintain a centralized repository for tracking the allocation and status of secret authentication information.
Regularly review and update the management process to ensure compliance with security policies and best practices.
Train users on the importance of safeguarding their secret authentication information and the procedures for reporting any security incidents.

controls.name: review of user access rights
controls.description: Asset owners shall review usersΓÇÖ access rights at regular intervals.

deployment_points.name: Define a schedule for regular reviews of user access rights, such as quarterly or bi-annually.
Assign asset owners the responsibility to conduct these reviews and ensure they have the necessary tools and access to perform them.
Document the review process, including criteria for access rights and any changes made during the review.
Implement a mechanism for tracking and reporting on the outcomes of the access rights reviews.
Communicate the results of the reviews to relevant stakeholders and take corrective actions as necessary.

controls.name: removal or adjustment of access rights
controls.description: The access rights of all employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal procedure for the timely removal or adjustment of access rights upon termination or change of employment status.
Ensure that HR and IT departments collaborate to communicate changes in employment status promptly.
Implement automated systems to revoke access rights immediately upon termination or change of role.
Maintain logs of access rights changes for auditing and compliance purposes.
Regularly review and test the effectiveness of the access rights removal process to ensure it functions as intended.

controls.name: use of secret authentication information
controls.description: Users shall be required to follow the organizationΓÇÖs practices in the use of secret authentication information.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document clear guidelines for the proper use of secret authentication information, including password creation and management.

Implement technical controls to enforce password policies, such as complexity requirements and expiration periods.
Monitor user compliance with the established practices and provide feedback or corrective actions as necessary.
Regularly review and update the guidelines to reflect changes in technology and security threats.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop an access control policy that clearly defines user roles and the corresponding access levels required for information and application systems.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) mechanisms to enforce the access restrictions defined in the policy.
Regularly audit access controls to ensure compliance with the access control policy and identify any unauthorized access.
Provide training to users on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to it.
Continuously review and update the access control policy to address new risks and changes in the organizational structure.

controls.name: secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

deployment_points.name: Define secure log-on procedures that include multi-factor authentication where appropriate.
Implement technical solutions to enforce these log-on procedures across all systems and applications.
Train users on the secure log-on procedures and the importance of maintaining the confidentiality of their authentication credentials.
Regularly test and review the effectiveness of the log-on procedures to identify any vulnerabilities.
Update the log-on procedures as necessary to incorporate new security technologies and practices.

controls.name: password management system
controls.description: Password management systems shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

deployment_points.name: Implement an interactive password management system that enforces strong password policies, including complexity and length requirements.
Provide users with guidance on creating and managing secure passwords through the system.
Regularly review and update the password management system to incorporate the latest security standards and practices.
Monitor user compliance with password policies and provide feedback or corrective actions as necessary.
Ensure the password management system includes features for password recovery and reset while maintaining security.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs and assess their potential risks to system and application controls.
Develop a policy that restricts the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Implement logging and monitoring mechanisms to track the use of privileged utility programs.
Provide training to authorized users on the risks associated with these programs and the importance of following the policy.
Regularly review and audit the use of privileged utility programs to ensure compliance with the established policy.

controls.name: access control to program source code
controls.description: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can access program source code and under what conditions.
Implement technical controls to enforce these access restrictions, such as version control systems with access permissions.
Regularly audit access to program source code to ensure compliance with the access control policies.
Provide training to developers and other relevant personnel on the importance of protecting source code.
Continuously review and update access control policies to address new security threats and changes in the development environment.

controls_data.name: Policy On The Use Of Cryptographic Controls

controls.name: policy on the use of cryptographic controls
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive policy outlining the use of cryptographic controls for protecting sensitive information.
