deployment_points.name: Research and select automated configuration monitoring tools that align with organizational needs and compliance requirements.
Deploy the selected tools across all relevant systems and applications, ensuring they are properly configured to monitor for compliance.
Establish baseline configurations for all systems to serve as a reference for compliance checks and unauthorized change detection.
Schedule regular scans and reports from the monitoring tools to identify deviations from established configurations.
Develop a response plan for addressing any unauthorized changes detected by the monitoring tools, including investigation and remediation steps.

controls.name: regularly review and update configurations
controls.description: Regularly review and update configurations to address changes in technology and security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of all configurations, ensuring they are assessed at least annually or whenever significant changes occur.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the review process to gather insights on necessary updates based on current technology and security trends.
Document any changes made during the review process, including the rationale for updates and the impact on security posture.
Communicate updated configurations to all relevant personnel, ensuring they are aware of changes and their implications.
Monitor the effectiveness of updated configurations through ongoing assessments and audits to ensure they meet security requirements.

controls.name: train staff on configuration management
controls.description: Train staff on configuration management processes and the importance of maintaining secure configurations.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training program that covers the principles of configuration management, including policies, procedures, and best practices.
Schedule regular training sessions for all staff involved in configuration management, ensuring participation is mandatory.
Use a variety of training methods, such as workshops, e-learning, and hands-on exercises, to engage staff and reinforce learning.
Assess staff understanding through quizzes or practical assessments to ensure they grasp the importance of secure configurations.
Provide ongoing training updates as new technologies and security practices emerge, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

controls.name: establish a data retention policy
controls.description: Establish a data retention policy that defines how long different types of information should be retained before deletion.

deployment_points.name: Draft a data retention policy that categorizes information types and specifies retention periods based on legal, regulatory, and business requirements.
Obtain approval for the policy from relevant stakeholders, including legal and compliance teams, to ensure alignment with obligations.
Communicate the data retention policy to all employees, ensuring they understand their responsibilities regarding data management.
Review and update the policy regularly to reflect changes in regulations, business needs, or technology.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the data retention policy, including audits and reporting.

controls.name: implement automated deletion processes
controls.description: Implement automated processes for identifying and deleting information that is no longer required based on the retention policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop automated scripts or use software tools to identify data that meets the criteria for deletion as outlined in the data retention policy.
Schedule regular automated deletion processes to run at defined intervals, ensuring timely removal of unnecessary data.
Implement safeguards to prevent accidental deletion of critical data, such as requiring approvals or notifications before deletion occurs.
Document all automated deletion activities, including what data was deleted and the rationale for its removal.
Regularly review and test the automated deletion processes to ensure they function correctly and comply with the data retention policy.

controls.name: ensure compliance with data destruction standards
controls.description: Ensure that deletion methods comply with industry standards for data destruction to prevent unauthorized recovery.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document the industry standards applicable to data destruction relevant to your organization.
Develop and implement a data destruction policy that aligns with these standards, detailing the methods and tools to be used.
Train relevant personnel on the approved data destruction methods and the importance of compliance with the standards.
Schedule regular audits to ensure that data destruction activities are performed according to the established policy and standards.
Maintain records of all data destruction activities to provide evidence of compliance and to facilitate future audits.

controls.name: document deletion activities
controls.description: Document all deletion activities to maintain an audit trail and demonstrate compliance with the retention policy.

deployment_points.name: Establish a standardized format for documenting deletion activities, including date, time, method, and personnel involved.
Implement a centralized logging system where all deletion activities are recorded in real-time.
Ensure that all employees involved in data deletion are trained on the documentation process and its importance for compliance.
Conduct periodic reviews of the documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy, addressing any discrepancies found.
Retain documentation for a specified period as defined by the organization's retention policy to support audits and compliance checks.

controls.name: train employees on data deletion
controls.description: Train employees on the importance of data deletion and the procedures for securely disposing of information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive training program that covers the importance of data deletion and the associated risks of non-compliance.
Schedule regular training sessions for all employees, ensuring that new hires receive training as part of their onboarding process.
Utilize various training methods, such as workshops, e-learning modules, and hands-on demonstrations, to cater to different learning styles.
Assess employee understanding through quizzes or practical exercises to ensure they grasp the procedures for secure data disposal.
Provide ongoing support and resources, such as a dedicated helpdesk or online materials, to assist employees with questions related to data deletion.

controls.name: develop a data masking policy
controls.description: Develop a data masking policy that outlines the types of data to be masked and the circumstances under which masking is required.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of sensitive data within the organization that require masking to protect against unauthorized access.
Draft a data masking policy that specifies the criteria for when and how data masking should be applied.
Involve key stakeholders, including legal and compliance teams, in the policy development process to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.
Communicate the finalized data masking policy to all relevant employees and provide training on its implementation.
Review and update the policy regularly to adapt to changes in regulations, technology, and business needs.

controls.name: implement data masking techniques
controls.description: Implement data masking techniques in databases and applications to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Assess existing databases and applications to identify where data masking techniques need to be applied.
Select appropriate data masking tools and techniques that align with the organization's data protection requirements.
Implement the chosen data masking techniques in a controlled environment, testing for effectiveness and performance impact.
Train IT staff on the implementation and maintenance of data masking solutions to ensure proper usage and troubleshooting.
Monitor the effectiveness of data masking measures regularly and adjust as necessary to address any vulnerabilities or compliance issues.

controls.name: review and update data masking procedures
controls.description: Regularly review and update data masking procedures to ensure compliance with relevant legislation and business requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of data masking procedures, ensuring they are aligned with current legislation and business practices.
Gather feedback from users and stakeholders to identify areas for improvement in the existing data masking procedures.
Update procedures as necessary, documenting any changes made and the rationale behind them.
Communicate updates to all relevant personnel and provide training on any new procedures or changes.
Maintain a version history of data masking procedures to track changes over time and facilitate audits.

controls.name: train staff on data masking
controls.description: Train staff on the importance of data masking and how to implement it effectively in their workflows.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training curriculum that covers the principles of data masking and its significance in protecting sensitive information.
Schedule training sessions for all staff who handle sensitive data, ensuring participation is mandatory.
Use real-world scenarios and case studies to illustrate the consequences of inadequate data masking practices.
Provide hands-on training on the tools and techniques used for data masking within the organization.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the training through assessments and feedback, making improvements as needed.

controls.name: monitor and audit data masking measures
controls.description: Monitor and audit the effectiveness of data masking measures to ensure they are functioning as intended.

deployment_points.name: Establish monitoring protocols to regularly assess the effectiveness of data masking measures in place.
Conduct audits of data masking implementations to ensure compliance with established policies and procedures.
Utilize automated tools where possible to streamline the monitoring and auditing process, ensuring timely detection of issues.
Document findings from audits and monitoring activities, including any identified weaknesses or areas for improvement.
Report audit results to management and relevant stakeholders, and develop action plans to address any deficiencies.

controls.name: implement data leakage prevention solutions
controls.description: Implement data leakage prevention (DLP) solutions to monitor and control the movement of sensitive information across networks and devices.

deployment_points.name: Assess the organization's data flow to identify potential leakage points and determine the necessary DLP solutions.
Select and deploy DLP tools that align with the organization's security requirements and data protection policies.
Configure DLP solutions to monitor, detect, and respond to unauthorized data transfers or access attempts.
Train employees on the importance of DLP and how to recognize and report potential data leakage incidents.
Regularly review and update DLP configurations and policies to adapt to new threats and changes in the organizational environment.

controls.name: define and classify sensitive information
controls.description: Define and classify sensitive information to ensure that DLP measures are appropriately targeted.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes sensitive information based on its level of confidentiality and regulatory requirements.
Involve key stakeholders in the classification process to ensure all types of sensitive data are identified and categorized.
Document the classification criteria and ensure it is accessible to all employees who handle sensitive information.
Train staff on the classification scheme and the importance of correctly identifying and handling sensitive data.
Regularly review and update the classification scheme to reflect changes in regulations, business needs, and data types.

controls.name: establish policies for data leakage incidents
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to data leakage incidents, including containment and notification processes.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal policy document outlining the procedures for identifying, reporting, and responding to data leakage incidents.
Define roles and responsibilities for incident response team members, ensuring clear communication channels are established.
Implement a notification process that includes timely alerts to affected parties and regulatory bodies as required.
Conduct regular training sessions for employees on the data leakage policies to ensure awareness and compliance.
Review and update the policies annually or after significant incidents to incorporate lessons learned and improve response strategies.

controls.name: review and update dlp policies
controls.description: Regularly review and update DLP policies to address new threats and changes in business operations.

deployment_points.name: Schedule quarterly reviews of the DLP policies to assess their effectiveness against current threats and vulnerabilities.
Gather input from stakeholders across departments to identify changes in business operations that may impact DLP requirements.
Update the policies to reflect new regulatory requirements, technological advancements, and emerging threats.
Communicate any changes to the DLP policies to all employees and provide training on new procedures.
Document the review process and maintain records of changes made to ensure accountability and compliance.

controls.name: provide training on data leakage prevention
controls.description: Provide training to employees on data leakage prevention practices and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive training program that covers data leakage prevention practices, policies, and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.
Schedule regular training sessions for all employees, ensuring that new hires receive training during onboarding.
Utilize various training methods, such as workshops, e-learning modules, and simulations, to engage employees effectively.
Assess employee understanding through quizzes or practical exercises to reinforce learning and identify knowledge gaps.
Maintain records of training completion and feedback to continuously improve the training program.

controls.name: establish a backup policy
controls.description: Establish a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up data and systems.

deployment_points.name: Create a formal backup policy document that specifies the types of data to be backed up, backup frequency, and retention periods.
Identify critical systems and data that require regular backups and prioritize them in the policy.
Define the methods for backing up data, including full, incremental, and differential backups, and the technologies to be used.
Ensure the policy includes guidelines for secure storage of backup copies, both onsite and offsite.
Review and update the backup policy annually or as needed to adapt to changes in business needs or technology.

controls.name: implement automated backup solutions
controls.description: Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of critical information and systems.

deployment_points.name: Research and select appropriate automated backup solutions that meet the organization's needs and compliance requirements.
Configure the backup software to perform regular backups according to the established backup policy, including scheduling and frequency.
Test the automated backup processes to ensure they are functioning correctly and capturing all necessary data.
Monitor backup logs and alerts to identify and resolve any issues promptly, ensuring data integrity.
Regularly review and update the backup configurations to accommodate changes in data volume or system architecture.

controls.name: schedule testing of backup restoration processes
controls.description: Schedule regular testing of backup restoration processes to verify data integrity and recovery capabilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a testing schedule that outlines how often backup restoration tests will be conducted, ideally at least bi-annually.
Create a detailed plan for the restoration process, including the steps to restore data from backups and the systems involved.
Conduct restoration tests in a controlled environment to minimize disruption to production systems and verify data integrity.
Document the results of each test, noting any issues encountered and actions taken to resolve them.
Use the findings from the tests to improve backup processes and update the backup policy as necessary.

controls.name: store backup copies securely
controls.description: Store backup copies in secure, offsite locations to protect against data loss from physical disasters.

deployment_points.name: Identify secure offsite locations for storing backup copies, ensuring they are protected against physical threats such as fire or flooding.
Implement encryption for backup data to protect sensitive information during storage and transit.
Establish access controls to limit who can access the backup storage locations and ensure only authorized personnel have access.
Regularly review the security measures in place for backup storage to ensure they remain effective and compliant with policies.
Maintain a log of all backup copies stored offsite, including their locations and access history for accountability.

controls.name: document and review backup procedures
controls.description: Document and review backup procedures regularly to ensure compliance with the established policy and make necessary updates.

deployment_points.name: Create detailed documentation of all backup procedures, including step-by-step instructions for performing backups and restorations.
Schedule regular reviews of the documentation to ensure it reflects current practices and technologies used.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the review process to gather feedback and identify areas for improvement.
Update the documentation promptly when changes are made to backup processes or technologies to maintain accuracy.
Store the documentation in a centralized location accessible to all personnel involved in backup operations.

controls.name: assess availability requirements
controls.description: Assess the availability requirements of critical information processing facilities to determine necessary redundancy levels.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough analysis of critical information processing facilities to identify their availability requirements based on business needs.
Engage with stakeholders to understand the impact of downtime on operations and establish acceptable downtime thresholds.
Document the findings of the assessment, including the required redundancy levels for each facility.
Use the assessment results to inform decisions on infrastructure investments and redundancy implementations.
Review the availability requirements periodically to ensure they remain aligned with changing business operations and technology.

controls.name: implement redundant systems
controls.description: Implement redundant systems, such as failover servers or load balancers, to ensure continuous operation during failures.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical systems that require redundancy and determine the appropriate type of redundant systems to implement.
Design the architecture for redundant systems, ensuring they can seamlessly take over in case of a failure.
Configure failover mechanisms and load balancers to distribute workloads and maintain system availability.
Test the redundant systems regularly to ensure they function correctly and can handle failover scenarios without data loss.
Document the configuration and testing results of the redundant systems to maintain a clear record of their operational status.

controls.name: test failover mechanisms
controls.description: Regularly test the failover mechanisms to ensure they function correctly and meet availability standards.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular failover tests at least quarterly to ensure mechanisms are functioning as intended.
Document the testing procedures, including the steps to initiate failover and the expected outcomes.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the testing process to validate the effectiveness of the failover mechanisms.
Analyze the results of each test to identify any issues or areas for improvement in the failover process.
Update the failover testing plan based on lessons learned and changes in technology or business requirements.

controls.name: monitor performance of redundant systems
controls.description: Monitor the performance of redundant systems to identify and address any potential issues proactively.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools that provide real-time performance metrics for all redundant systems.
Set thresholds for performance indicators to trigger alerts when systems deviate from expected performance.
Regularly review performance data to identify trends or recurring issues that may require attention.
Establish a response plan for addressing performance issues, including escalation procedures and remediation steps.
Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring configurations to ensure they align with current system architecture and business needs.

controls.name: document redundancy architecture
controls.description: Document the redundancy architecture and update it as necessary to reflect changes in technology or business needs.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive diagram of the redundancy architecture, including all components and their interconnections.
Maintain a version-controlled document that outlines the redundancy architecture and any changes made over time.
Review and update the documentation whenever there are changes in technology, business processes, or system configurations.
Ensure that the documentation is accessible to relevant personnel and includes clear instructions for implementation.
Conduct training sessions to familiarize staff with the redundancy architecture and its importance in maintaining system availability.

controls.name: implement logging mechanisms
controls.description: Implement logging mechanisms across all information processing systems to capture relevant events and activities.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical systems and applications that require logging and define the types of events to be logged.
Configure logging mechanisms to capture relevant data, including timestamps, user actions, and system events.
Ensure that logs are generated in a standardized format to facilitate analysis and correlation.
Test the logging mechanisms to verify that they are functioning correctly and capturing the necessary information.
Regularly review and update logging configurations to adapt to changes in systems and compliance requirements.

controls.name: ensure secure log storage
controls.description: Ensure logs are stored securely and protected from unauthorized access or tampering.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict log access to authorized personnel only.
Use encryption to protect logs both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access.
Regularly back up logs to a secure location to ensure data integrity and availability.
Monitor log storage for any unauthorized access attempts or anomalies that may indicate a security breach.
Establish a retention policy for logs that complies with legal and regulatory requirements while ensuring secure deletion of outdated logs.

controls.name: review and analyze logs
controls.description: Regularly review and analyze logs to identify anomalies or security incidents that require further investigation.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular log review sessions, at least monthly, to analyze logs for unusual patterns or activities.
Utilize automated tools to assist in log analysis and to flag potential security incidents for further investigation.
Document findings from log reviews and escalate any identified issues to the appropriate response teams.
Train staff on how to interpret log data and recognize signs of potential security incidents.
Continuously refine log review processes based on feedback and evolving security threats.

controls.name: establish retention policies for logs
controls.description: Establish retention policies for logs to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

deployment_points.name: Research and identify applicable legal and regulatory requirements for log retention in your industry.
Develop a formal log retention policy that specifies retention periods for different types of logs.
Communicate the retention policy to all relevant stakeholders and ensure compliance across the organization.
Implement automated processes for archiving and securely deleting logs that exceed retention periods.
Regularly review and update the retention policy to reflect changes in regulations or business needs.

controls.name: train staff on logging
controls.description: Train staff on the importance of logging and how to respond to findings from log analysis.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training program that covers the importance of logging and the role it plays in security and compliance.
Schedule regular training sessions for all relevant staff, ensuring new hires receive training as part of their onboarding.
Include practical exercises in the training to help staff understand how to analyze logs and respond to findings.
Provide ongoing education and updates on logging best practices and emerging threats.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the training program through assessments and feedback from participants.

controls.name: deploy monitoring tools for anomalous behavior
controls.description: Deploy monitoring tools that can detect anomalous behavior across networks, systems, and applications.

deployment_points.name: Identify and select appropriate monitoring tools that align with the organization's security requirements and infrastructure.
Configure the monitoring tools to detect specific types of anomalous behavior based on established baselines.
Integrate monitoring tools with existing security systems to enhance overall threat detection capabilities.
Regularly update and maintain monitoring tools to ensure they are effective against evolving threats.
Train staff on how to interpret alerts generated by monitoring tools and respond appropriately to potential incidents.

controls.name: establish baseline behavior
controls.description: Establish baseline behavior for normal operations to identify deviations that may indicate security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Analyze historical data to determine normal operational patterns for systems and applications.
Document baseline behavior, including typical user activity, system performance metrics, and network traffic patterns.
Regularly review and update baseline behavior to reflect changes in business operations or technology.
Use the established baseline to configure monitoring tools to detect deviations that may indicate security incidents.
Communicate baseline behavior to relevant staff to ensure awareness and understanding of normal operations.

controls.name: create incident response procedures
controls.description: Create incident response procedures to address detected anomalies promptly and effectively.

deployment_points.name: Define the scope of the incident response procedures, including types of anomalies to be addressed.
Develop a step-by-step response plan detailing actions to take upon detection of an anomaly.
Assign roles and responsibilities to team members for executing the incident response procedures.
Establish communication protocols for reporting and escalating incidents to relevant stakeholders.
Regularly test and update the incident response procedures to ensure effectiveness and relevance.

controls.name: train personnel on monitoring tools
controls.description: Train personnel on how to use monitoring tools and interpret alerts to ensure timely responses to potential incidents.

controls.name: review and update monitoring strategies

Update monitoring tools and techniques based on the latest threat intelligence and industry best practices.

controls.name: identify approved time sources
controls.description: Identify and configure approved time sources, such as NTP servers, for synchronizing system clocks.

controls.name: implement automated synchronization processes

Document the results of time accuracy checks and any corrective actions taken.

controls.name: document time synchronization process

controls.name: train it staff on time synchronization

controls.name: identify utility programs

Document the purpose and usage of each identified utility program for future reference.
Review the inventory regularly to ensure it remains up-to-date with any new utility programs introduced.

controls.name: establish access controls for utility programs
controls.description: Establish strict access controls and permissions for the use of these utility programs to limit their availability.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can use utility programs and under what circumstances.
Implement role-based access controls to restrict access to utility programs based on job responsibilities.
Regularly review and update access permissions to ensure they align with current organizational needs.

controls.name: develop a formal process for software installation

Establish a software approval committee to review and authorize new software installations based on security and operational needs.

controls.name: restrict software installation privileges

Implement access controls to restrict software installation capabilities to only those authorized personnel.

controls.name: implement a change management system
controls.description: Implement a change management system to track and review all software installations and updates.

deployment_points.name: Select and configure a change management tool that meets the organization's needs for tracking software changes.

controls.name: regularly audit installed software

Create a comprehensive inventory of all installed software, including version numbers and licensing information.

Document audit findings and communicate them to relevant stakeholders for corrective action.

controls.name: train staff on secure software installation

Regularly update firewall and intrusion detection system configurations to adapt to new threats and vulnerabilities.
Conduct periodic reviews and tests of the firewall and intrusion detection systems to ensure they are functioning effectively.

controls.name: regularly update and patch network devices

Establish a patch management policy that defines the frequency and process for updating network devices.
Monitor vendor announcements for security updates and patches relevant to the organization's network devices.
Test patches in a controlled environment before deploying them to production devices to minimize disruption.
Document all updates and patches applied to network devices for compliance and auditing purposes.

controls.name: conduct network segmentation

controls.name: monitor network traffic

controls.name: conduct periodic reviews of network service security measures
controls.description: Conduct periodic reviews and updates of network service security measures to adapt to changing threats.

controls.name: train staff on network service security

controls.name: identify and classify information services

controls.name: review and update segregation policies
